metrics.name: Booking provisioning (payment -> booking)
metrics.description: For every successful booking-fee payment, did we create a booking record against that same transaction?

metrics.name: BFP auto-refund SLA (7-day)
metrics.description: For bookings/BFPs not installed within 7 days, was the auto-refund issued within SLA?

metrics.name: Address Submitted -> Booking Confirmed (24h) %
metrics.description: For every customer who submits their address, do they go on to confirm the booking within 24 hours (either direction, session-deduped)? Values are a 0-1 fraction.

metrics.name: Install TRUM plan creation within 30 mins
metrics.description: For every install reaching the awaiting-customer-OTP step, was the TRUM plan created within 30 minutes of it?

metrics.name: Device live at install (ping within 30 min)
metrics.description: For every install reaching the awaiting-customer-OTP step, did the device show any ping activity within 30 minutes of it?

metrics.name: Rating done to happy code delivered on chat
metrics.description: For every install rating submitted, was the happy-code confirmation delivered via chat around the same time?

metrics.name: Technician assigned msg to customer
metrics.description: For every technician assignment, was the customer notified via chat within 10 minutes?

metrics.name: Renewal Reminder - R0 (sent within 24h before expiry)
metrics.description: For every plan expiry, was the R0 reminder sent within 24 hours before it?

metrics.name: Recharge to device live within 2h
metrics.description: For every recharge, did the device come back online within 2 hours of the plan start?

metrics.name: Renewal provisioning (payment -> plan & entitlement)
metrics.description: For every successful renewal payment, did we create the plan and the entitlement?

metrics.name: No free usage after Wiom expiry (ISP active)
metrics.description: Of customers whose Wiom plan expired while the ISP is still live, the share showing ~zero data usage that day.

metrics.name: Customer plan ISP coverage (paid-hour level)
metrics.description: Of every hour a customer paid for, what share actually had the ISP gate open?

metrics.name: Customers NOT affected rate (100 - % customers affected)
metrics.description: Of paying customers, what share had zero blocked hours in the period?

metrics.name: Captive Portal triggered -> Captive portal open
metrics.description: For every captive portal trigger, did the portal actually open on the customer device?

metrics.name: % Refund Requested (PAYG)
metrics.description: Of all PUT tickets created for PAYG customers, what share have a security-deposit refund order created?

metrics.name: % Refund Processed (PAYG)
metrics.description: Of completed pickup tickets, excluding cases stuck at netbox-returned-no-UPI, what share have the refund actually in PROCESSING or SUCCESSFUL?

metrics.name: % Refund Orders stuck >72h in Processing (PAYG)
metrics.description: Of PAYG refund orders that entered PROCESSING at least 72h ago, what share have NOT reached SUCCESSFUL within 72 hours?
